title: Timeline
description: Timeline displays chronological activity, audit events, and process updates along a vertical or horizontal axis with semantic markers, timestamps, and optional custom content.
intro: Use `ui-timeline` with an `items` array for data-driven feeds, or compose `ui-timeline-item` children when a row needs tags, buttons, or richer custom content. Each item supports title, timestamp, meta, description, icon markers, variants, and a pending state.
importCode: import { TimelineComponent, TimelineItemComponent, type TimelineItem } from 'ui';

featureSections.title: Activity feed
featureSections.description: A compact release activity feed with title, timestamp, actor meta, and supporting description text.

featureSections.title: Semantic variants and pending state
featureSections.description: Use variants to communicate status. The pending state renders a dashed marker for in-progress steps.

featureSections.title: Audit trail
featureSections.description: A realistic enterprise audit trail with actor metadata, icons, and mixed event severities.

featureSections.title: Custom row content
featureSections.description: Project tags, buttons, and other supporting UI inside a timeline row through `ui-timeline-item` content projection.

accessibility.title: Structure
accessibility.body: The timeline renders as a list with one list item per event. Provide `ariaLabel` when multiple timelines appear on the same page.

accessibility.title: Timestamps and headings
accessibility.body: Each event title is rendered as a heading level 3 inside its row. Timestamps use a `time` element for clearer scanning, even when the value is a relative label like `Pending`.

accessibility.title: Decorative rail
accessibility.body: Markers and connector lines are marked `aria-hidden` so screen readers focus on the textual event content.

apiSections.title: TimelineComponent - ui-timeline
apiSections.lead: Container for chronological events. Pass `items` for data-driven rendering or project `ui-timeline-item` children for composed rows.

blocks.title: Inputs
rows: Data-driven timeline entries. When empty, projected `ui-timeline-item` children are rendered.
Layout direction for the timeline axis.
Reverses the order of `items` before rendering.
Accessible name for the timeline list.

apiSections.title: TimelineItemComponent - ui-timeline-item
apiSections.lead: Single timeline row with marker, connector line, textual content, and optional projected body content.

blocks.title: Inputs
rows: Time or relative label shown on the right.
Secondary metadata such as actor or channel.

blocks.title: TimelineItem model
paragraphs: The `TimelineItem` interface mirrors the component inputs and adds a required `id` field for stable tracking in data-driven mode.
